name: Tiquiz
summary: Builds AI quiz funnels that tag leads and send them to Systeme.io, GoHighLevel or a webhook, with a free plan and clear paid tiers.
description: Tiquiz is a quiz builder that captures leads and sends the result and tag to Systeme.io, GoHighLevel or any tool by webhook. No card is required to start on Free.

pricing.details: Free forever (1 quiz, 1 survey and 1 Popquiz; 10 leads visible over 30 days; no card). Tiquiz 15 €/month or 152 €/year; Tiquiz PLUS 26 €/month or 259 €/year.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: AI quiz funnels with lead tagging
Follow-up emails and custom domain on paid plans
